interpretation.membership: Exact arithmetic in the selected external families.

interpretation.partial: No named certificate is complete, but at least one has some supporting requests or dependencies.
interpretation.snapshot: Queries read this saved snapshot; they do not silently recompute against a changed or missing source.
interpretation.spiral: A witnessed scalar lineage does not require the later direct target-shell certificate; complex multiplication remains an external interpretation.
interpretation.unwitnessed: No named certificate has supporting witnesses; mathematical membership remains exact.
interpretation.witnessed: At least one named certificate is complete. Inspect its criterion; this does not assert a literal fractional-input edge.

interpretation.discovery: This worked comparison explains known identities and operand rules; it establishes no new geometric or timing law.
interpretation.lineage: Seed direct shell plus successive scalar transitions. Joint availability, not a chronological execution trace.
interpretation.prediction: predicted_stage_with_wide_retention is arithmetic operand readiness, not a witness beyond the source checkpoint.
interpretation.selection: Missing selected lineage support does not exclude another construction of the same state. A scalar join does not identify a shared configuration.
interpretation.splits: All ordered i+j=n through n=4. source_composition also requires both DIRECT source shells; its stage may exceed the linked-lineage stage.

query.interpretation: Every selector must match the same value through its specified role, or any role when omitted. Sharing a scalar value does not establish the same configuration or a construction dependency; inspect the matched association references. A stage cutoff requires complete relationship support by that stage. Results are bounded selections, not statistical correlations or a complete branch discovery.
